execution_stages.name: pilot_goal_intake
execution_stages.description: CEO defines pilot unlock strategy and overall harness scope.

execution_stages.name: pilot_use_case_selection
execution_stages.description: Sales AI selects the safest single pilot use case worth unlocking in the future.

execution_stages.name: compliance_checks_briefing
execution_stages.description: COO defines the one-action approval workflow and distribues briefings to departments.

execution_stages.name: content_claims_validation
execution_stages.description: CMO defines subject/body/CTA templates, unsubscribe footer guidelines, and claim-safety rules.

execution_stages.name: pricing_and_discount_review
execution_stages.description: CFO reviews offer content for price anchor and discount compliance.

execution_stages.name: operational_risk_review
execution_stages.description: Research AI reviews operational risks and details possible escalation boundaries.

execution_stages.name: provider_adapter_setup
execution_stages.description: CTO defines the fake provider adapter, allowlist gate, duplicate-send protection model, and idempotency key constraints.

execution_stages.name: followup_boundary_planning
execution_stages.description: CS AI defines manual follow-up boundaries and reply expectations.

execution_stages.name: qa_safety_block_verification
execution_stages.description: QA reviews script execution to enforce zero-send, fake-only provider status, and no-credentials policies.

execution_stages.name: learning_retrospective
execution_stages.description: CLO Hermes records lessons learned and recommends future pilot unlock criteria.
